_about: Gear for chapter 1: four slots (Robin, 2026-11-20, 'The big pieces': every cutlass, buckler and hat has its own shape; coats come in a handful of looks), three tiers, four rarities. A piece is a base and a rarity; its numbers are the base's times the rarity's `times`, and never less than the base plus one for each step of rarity. Affixes, uniques and sets are chapter 2. `value` is what a common one is worth; the shop sells at value times `buyTimes` and buys at value times `sellShare`. Names are Victor, GD's placeholders. Since the house (Robin, 2026-11-20: pin and button; better gear is other found things) the NAMES are the house's; the ids are still the pirate game's, because Leonard, AD's gear pictures are keyed by them. They change when his gear for the house lands.

rarities._about: weight is how often a drop is of that rarity. The colours are Leonard, AD's (his loot drop of 2026-11-20; Robin's to judge): the ring on the ground and the edge in the bag.

shop._about: A stall of a few pieces, new ones each time he comes to town (Zite's lesson: a phone screen shows a few things; rotate, don't list). The tier on sale follows his level.
